title: Saul's Oath and Jonathan Eating Honey
description: Saul places the people under a strict oath not to eat until evening. Jonathan, who has not heard the oath, tastes some honey and is strengthened. The people become exhausted, and after defeating the Philistines, they sin by eating meat with the blood still in it. Saul makes them slaughter the animals on a large stone and builds his first altar to the Lord.
